title: 第3260章 刻入极霜大阵第3259章 斩杀雪魔虫王
lines: “可以开始了……”
隐蔽的山洞中，
萧诺布置好了诸多防御阵法，接下来开始准备在身上刻入“极霜大阵”，只要完成了阵法的刻入，《大道混元经》的第四层就会变得更强。
到时候，极霜大阵和混元大阵进行融合，便可成为萧诺更厉害的杀招。
倾城酒仙说道：“你要时刻注意自己的情况，万一承受不住了，一定要及时停止！”
倾城酒仙显然还是有所担心的。
毕竟《大道混元经》是一部残篇。
萧诺之所以能够修炼到第四阶段，完全是由《鸿蒙霸体诀》打下的坚实基础。
要是换做寻常的修士，可能第一阶段都修炼不来。
萧诺点点头：“我明白，你们无需担心！”
萧诺的底气还是很充足的。
这一次，九位女帝妖后全部都是苏醒的状态。
而且塔灵也没有沉睡。
即便发生了问题，塔灵也会做出应对。
杀生神女说道：“先让月瑶法神帮你拆解一下‘极霜大阵’的全部构造吧！到时候，你以‘霜灵涎’为刻画阵纹的材料，将阵法融入自身，就像当初你在身上刻入‘混元大阵’的时候一样！”
萧诺再度点点头：“嗯！”
当初萧诺第一次“以身为阵”的时候，还是在东神域。
那时候，萧诺在身上刻下混元大阵，过程艰辛且痛苦。
但萧诺硬生生的扛了下来。
萧诺并没有任何的怨言，武道一途，本就如此。
若想追寻力量的巅峰，必然是要披荆斩棘，乘风破浪。
月瑶法神慵懒的说道：“你帮他拆解就行了……”
她语气有些不太情愿，说话的时候还在打着哈欠。
杀生神女道：“你讲述的更为详细，论阵法，我不如你！”
月瑶法神嘟囔道：“行吧！等我缓一下！”
虽然隔着鸿蒙金塔的封印，萧诺还是能隐约感受到月瑶法神身上的那股起床气。
萧诺不禁有些好笑，月瑶法神怎能如此喜欢睡觉？
圣心琴魔说道：“我来为你抚琴，洗去倦意！”
旋即，琴音奏响，如天上乐章，人间难遇。
圣心琴魔的琴声很独特，即便是萧诺也不由的沉醉于其中。
萧诺的内心愈发平静，如沐春风一般，全身放松。
一曲结束，萧诺耳聪目明，精神飒爽。
月瑶法神也来了精神，她开口道：“好了，我来教你逐步拆解‘极霜大阵’哈。”
萧诺回道：“嗯！”
接下来，在月瑶法神详细的解析下，萧诺对“极霜大阵”的了解更加透彻明了。
阵法的原理，其中的构造。
以及组成这座阵法的符文，全部都讲解的清清楚楚。
content_en:
"It's time to start..."
In a hidden cave,
Xiao Nuo has arranged many defensive formations, and then begins to prepare to carve the "Extreme Frost Formation" into his body. As long as the carving of the formations is completed, the fourth layer of "The Great Way of Hunyuan Jing" will become stronger.
When the time comes, the fusion of the Extreme Frost Formation and the Hunyuan Formation will become Xiao Nuo's more powerful killing move.
Qingcheng Jiuxian said: "You must always pay attention to your own situation. If you can't bear it anymore, you must stop in time!"
Qingcheng Jiuxian is obviously still worried.
After all, "Da Dao Hunyuan Jing" is a fragment.
The reason why Xiao Nuo was able to reach the fourth stage of cultivation was entirely due to the solid foundation laid by the "Hongmeng Hegemony Technique".
If it were an ordinary monk, he might not be able to complete the first stage of cultivation.
Xiao Nuo nodded: "I understand, you don't need to worry!"
Xiao Nuo still has plenty of confidence.
This time, all nine empresses and demon empresses were awake.
And the tower spirit is not sleeping either.
Even if a problem occurs, Talling will respond.
The Killing Goddess said: "Let Dharma God Yueyao help you dismantle the entire structure of the 'Extreme Frost Formation' first! At that time, you can use 'Frost Spirit Saliva' as the material to carve the formation patterns and integrate the formation into yourself, just like you did when you carved the 'Hunyuan Formation' into your body!"
Xiao Nuo nodded again: "Yes!"
When Xiao Nuo first "formed himself", he was still in the Eastern God Territory.
At that time, Xiao Nuo carved the Hunyuan Formation on his body, which was an arduous and painful process.
But Xiao Nuo endured it forcefully.
Xiao Nuo didn't have any complaints, it was just like that in the martial arts.
If you want to pursue the peak of strength, you must overcome obstacles and ride the wind and waves.
Yueyao Dharma God said lazily: "Just help him dismantle it..."
Her tone was somewhat reluctant, and she was yawning as she spoke.
The Killing Goddess said: "You told it in more detail. When it comes to formations, I am not as good as you!"
Dharma God Yueyao muttered: "Okay! Wait for me to slow down!"
Although separated by the seal of the Hongmeng Golden Pagoda, Xiao Nuo could still vaguely feel the arousal of Yueyao Dharma God.
Xiao Nuo couldn't help but feel a little funny. How could Dharma God Yueyao like to sleep so much?
The Sacred Heart Piano Demon said: "I'm here to play the piano for you and wash away your tiredness!"
Immediately, the sound of the piano was played, like heavenly music, rarely seen on earth.
The sound of the Holy Heart Piano Demon is very unique, and even Xiao Nuo can't help but be intoxicated by it.
Xiao Nuo's heart became calmer and calmer, and his whole body relaxed like a spring breeze.
At the end of the song, Xiao Nuoer was bright and energetic.
Dharma God Yueyao also became energetic. She said, "Okay, let me teach you how to dismantle the 'Extreme Frost Formation' step by step."
Xiao Nuo replied: "Yeah!"
Next, under the detailed analysis of Dharma God Yueyao, Xiao Nuo gained a more thorough understanding of the "Extreme Frost Formation".
The principles of the formation and its structure.
As well as the runes that make up this formation, all are explained clearly.
title_en: Chapter 3260 Carving into the Extreme Frost Formation Chapter 3259 Killing the Snow Demon Insect King
